description: This file contains functions and scripts for platform-specific upgrade operations on a Linux-based embedded system, specifically for the bcm27xx platform. It includes routines for checking images, performing upgrades, setting root partitions, and restoring backups.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the given image matches the current device's partition layout to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by comparing partition layouts and writing image data to appropriate device partitions.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in boot configuration based on a file or default device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Restores configuration files from a backup image to the device's boot partition.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores backup content to the device's root filesystem and sets the root partition.
